sentences.text: The FIR unfolds that Sri Pratap Kumar Gogoi filed for permission to transport 200 numbers of milch cows and buffaloes from Bihar and Uttar Pradesh to his dairy farm at Maidam Gaon, Beltola giving false address.

He obtained permit by permit No.LSV-19/RGE.Transportation/Pt-II/2022-23 dated 07.07.2022.
4.
During enquiry it was found that Pratap Kumar Gogoi had intentionally used a fake address while applying for permit.
Apart from this, Pratap Kumar Gogoi could not show his dairy farm at Maidam Gaon, Beltola.
Further, it is stated that his name and details were used by Sri Tarun Dihingia.
He also stated that no cattle was transported against the said permit.

It was later learnt in enquiry that Pratap Kumar Gogoi in connivance with Sri Tarun Dihingia and some unknown individuals hatched up a conspiracy and obtained permit fraudulently for a diary farm at Maidam Gaon, Beltola which was not in existence at all.
5. It is also revealed by Pratap Kumar Gogoi that he did not sign on any application for permit although he has given his documents to Tarun Dihingia.
It was also unearthed that the details of the consigner were not given in the application to evade further verification and thereby violated the rules of Assam Cattle Preservation Rules, 2022.
6. It is admitted that the present petitioner has given his signature on the permit but he was not aware that the documents for obtaining the permit was a fake document.
7. It is also submitted that the petitioner will cooperate with the investigation and he is innocent.
8. I have considered the submissions at the bar.
Page No.# 3/3 9.
To consider the bail application, case diary is necessary.

10. Call for the case diary, fixing the matter on 26.05.2023.
11.

In the interim and in the event of arrest of the petitioner above named, he shall be released on bail of Rs.35,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the condition that:
i.

The petitioner will appear before the IO and cooperate with the investigation;
ii.
The petitioner will refrain from such actives with he is alleged.
12. List accordingly on 26.05.2023.
